prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
Upper half: a High-Beak Auditor mid-ceremony at the Apex of the spire
colony, long ice-bladed sword held vertical before him, pale prismatic
glyph script hanging in the air around his palms as he reads the
ice-memory. Aurora band across a dark sky behind. Lower half: a plain warm
dark surface reserved for overlaid text, with a faint ghosted echo-script
watermark. Warm cream parchment frame.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor illustration on aged cream parchment, 3:4 vertical card face, richly pigmented Mary Blair–saturated palette. Upper two-thirds: a lean adult emperor penguin — tall upright posture, narrow pointed beak, small watchful dark eyes, sleek plumage — dressed as a High-Beak Auditor in pale ice-plate armor over flowing white robes, segmented silvered pauldrons etched with Chinese-influenced rank script, aurora-crystal coronet glinting luminous cyan at the brow. He holds a long ice-bladed sword vertical before him, the prismatic blade tip faintly glowing cool green. Pale prismatic glyph-script floats in the air around his open palms, cool aquamarine shimmer, meditative and slow. Behind him: a luminous deep-cobalt aurora band burns across a near-black #0D1A2D sky above crystalline spire architecture catching clean blue-white light. Lower third: flat warm #C18A63-toned dark ground reserved for text overlay, bearing a ghosted watermark of echo-script in deep slate. Cream parchment border frames the card. Lighting is cool and frontal from the aurora above, silvered highlights on every polished surface edge.
